title: Diffusion Fiction Lab: Chinese Chapter-Heading Couplets
description:
A curated release of the code, development and recall data, and retained development results for a study of Chinese chapter-heading couplets.

The unseen dataset and grading dry runs are excluded. Original project materials are MIT-licensed. Wikisource-derived material retains attribution and its documented source terms, including CC BY-SA 4.0 for contributions. See NOTICE.md.
